Tier2 link conversion with accessible names disabled

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"tier_strategy\":\"tier2\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convertWithAccessibleNames("<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", false, options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
